meta.description: RPGs and RPG hybrids published by Enix (1983-2003) and Square Enix (2003-present), compiled for an RPG play-tracker and recommender.
notes: The category page could not be fetched, so the data comes from Wikipedia's two 'List of Enix games' pages, which cover the same games.
Rows with a blank title in the source (remakes and ports) are attached to the game listed just above them and marked remake_or_port: true.
Games on both lists (e.g. Dragon Quest, Door Door, Portopia) are merged into one entry with all their releases.
Computer-game release years are inferred from table order (year_inferred: true); the extracted page did not include the year headings.
genres, rpg and series are curated tags, not taken from Wikipedia, except computer games whose genre the source text states.
54 games with no known genre were removed (2026-10-24).
90 non-RPG games were removed (2026-10-24); only rpg = yes or hybrid remain.
description: written for this project; story details for lesser-known games were checked against Wikipedia, MobyGames, Giant Bomb, PSX Datacenter, RPGFan, RPGamer and 8-bits.info (2026-10-24).
Blade Arts re-tagged as an action-adventure dungeon crawler (hybrid) and Mahoujin GuruGuru 2 as an action RPG after checking sources.

Square Enix list: only RPGs and RPG hybrids were added (about 140 of roughly 300 titles); sports, puzzle, rhythm, shooter, board and other non-RPG games were left out, as was Kenshin Dragon Quest, which its sources classify as an adventure game.

Remakes, ports and collections are stored as releases of the game they remake, not as separate games (e.g. Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake is a release of Dragon Quest III; Final Fantasy Pixel Remasters are releases of each Final Fantasy).
Games first released by Square or Quest before the 2003 merger and only remade by Square Enix include an original release entry from general knowledge, marked original_release: true.
Square Enix region flags come from each title's first row on the list; platforms merge all of that title's rows.
upcoming: true means no version is out yet as of 2026-10-31; those games can be added to a want-to-play list but not rated.
art: settings for the page's original pixel-art placeholder box; not real cover art.

field_definitions.rpg: yes = core RPG; hybrid = RPG mixed with another genre
field_definitions.regions: Per release: enix = published by Enix; square_enix = published by Square Enix; other_publisher = released there by a different publisher; not_released = not released in that region
field_definitions.released_in_english: true if any release reached North America or PAL regions
field_definitions.publishers: Companies that published releases of this game: Enix, Square Enix, or the original publisher (Square, Quest) for pre-merger originals
field_definitions.upcoming: true if no version has been released yet

games.title: Parallel World
games.description: One of Enix's earliest role-playing games, made by Toshiyuki Nagase for the Sharp X1 home computer. Its story isn't documented in English sources, so it's mainly of interest as a piece of Enix history from before Dragon Quest.

games.title: The Earth Fighter Rayieza
games.description: A science-fiction RPG for Japanese home computers, later ported to the Famicom with added side-scrolling planet landings. In the year 2300, aliens from deep space are attacking humanity's colonies. A young soldier in the Rayieza unit on Mars loses most of his comrades and has to fight his way back to Earth with Blue, the only other survivor.

games.title: Dragon Quest
games.description: The turn-based RPG that set the template for Japanese console RPGs: one hero, menu-driven battles and levels earned out on the world map. The Dragonlord has stolen the Ball of Light and kidnapped Princess Gwaelin. A descendant of the legendary hero Erdrick sets out alone to rescue her and defeat him.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake

games.title: Dragon Quest II
games.description: A turn-based RPG that grows the original into a party of three and a much larger world you can sail. A century after the first game, the wizard Hargon destroys the kingdom of Moonbrooke. The prince of Midenhall and his cousins from Cannock and Moonbrooke, all descendants of Erdrick, set out to stop him.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest I & II HD-2D Remake

games.title: Final Fantasy
games.description: The turn-based RPG that started the series: pick four heroes from six classes and explore a world of crystals, dungeons and, eventually, an airship. Four Warriors of Light arrive carrying darkened crystal orbs, rescue Princess Sarah from the knight Garland, and set out to restore the four elemental crystals as the world decays.

games.title: Dragon Quest III
games.description: A turn-based RPG where you build your own party from classes like warrior, priest and mage, and can later change their classes. On their sixteenth birthday, the child of the fallen hero Ortega leaves Aliahan to defeat the archfiend Baramos, in a journey that ties back to the legend of Erdrick.

games.title: Final Fantasy II
games.description: A turn-based RPG with no experience levels: characters improve the skills and stats they actually use in battle. Firion, Maria and Guy lose their home when the Palamecian Empire invades, and they join the rebels of Fynn in a war against the emperor and his armies from hell.

games.title: The Final Fantasy Legend
games.description: A turn-based RPG with humans, mutants and monsters as party members, each growing in a different way; monsters change form by eating meat. A party sets out to climb a giant tower said to lead to Paradise, crossing the worlds on each of its floors.

games.title: Dragon Quest IV
games.description: A turn-based RPG told in five chapters, each following different heroes before they join forces. It also introduced AI-controlled party tactics. A prophecy says a hero will rise to stop Psaro, who plans to wipe out humanity. The chapters follow a royal soldier, a tomboy princess, the merchant Torneko, two dancer sisters, and finally the chosen hero.

games.title: Final Fantasy III
games.description: A turn-based RPG built around a job system that lets four heroes switch between more than 20 classes. Four orphans from the village of Ur are chosen by the Wind Crystal as Warriors of Light, and set out to restore balance after an earthquake unleashes a flood of darkness.

games.title: Final Fantasy Legend II
games.description: A turn-based RPG with the same mix of human, mutant, robot and monster party members. A child sets out after their father, who left on a quest years ago, and searches several worlds for the MAGI, fragments of a goddess's statue that grant great power.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Fangs: The Saga of Wolf Blood
games.description: A role-playing game for Japanese home computers, released on the PC-8801 and others. Its monsters were designed by Yoshitaka Tamaki, known for Sega's Shining series. Its story isn't documented in English sources.

releases.listed_title: Fangs: The Saga of Wolf Blood

games.title: Final Fantasy Adventure
games.description: The first game in the Mana series, an action RPG on the Game Boy with real-time sword combat and a growing set of weapons. A gladiator escapes the Dark Lord of Glaive and, together with a heroine tied to the Mana Tree, races to stop the Dark Lord from claiming the tree's power.

games.title: Final Fantasy IV
games.description: A story-driven RPG that introduced the Active Time Battle system, where enemies act in real time while you choose commands. Cecil, a dark knight of Baron, begins to doubt his king after being ordered to steal crystals from peaceful lands, and seeks redemption as the sorcerer Golbez gathers the crystals for himself.

games.title: Final Fantasy Legend III
games.description: A turn-based RPG with time travel and party members who change form through parts and meat. Water from the Pureland is flooding the world, and a group of young heroes travels between past, present and future aboard the time machine Talon to stop it.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Dragon Quest V
games.description: A turn-based RPG that follows one hero from childhood to fatherhood, and lets you recruit defeated monsters into your party. As a boy, the hero travels with his father Pankraz in search of his kidnapped mother. Tragedy, years of slavery, marriage and a new generation follow, all tied to the cult leader Ladja and the demon lord behind him.

games.title: E.V.O.: Search for Eden
games.description: An action platformer with RPG-style growth: eat the creatures you defeat to earn evolution points, then spend them to evolve your jaws, body, legs and more. You start as a simple fish in the early oceans and, guided by Gaia, the spirit of the Earth, evolve through amphibians, reptiles and mammals across hundreds of millions of years.

games.title: Final Fantasy V
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a deep job system, where abilities learned in one class can be carried into another. The wanderer Bartz finds a fallen meteor and Princess Lenna, and joins a growing party trying to keep the four elemental crystals from shattering and freeing the sealed warlock Exdeath.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

sources: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Just Breed
games.description: A tactical RPG with turn-based battles in the style of Fire Emblem, in which your army moves unit by unit and monster dens keep spawning enemies until you close them. During a festival in the town of Astholm, the priestess Firis is kidnapped by Ezelkiel's henchmen, who are gathering priestesses to revive an ancient evil. Her lover, the town's sworn protector, leads his army to rescue her and is drawn into a wider crisis.

games.title: Romancing SaGa
games.description: A nonlinear RPG where you choose one of eight heroes and roam freely, as events open and close with time and new skills spark mid-battle. Long ago the evil god Saruin was sealed with ten Fatestones, and as the stones resurface, the heroes' journeys lead toward his return. The PS2 remake is known as Minstrel Song.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

sources: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Soul Blazer
games.description: An action RPG where you rebuild the world by destroying monster lairs, each of which frees a trapped soul. People, animals, plants and even objects come back to life and rebuild the towns. King Magridd sold every soul in his kingdom to the demon Deathtoll in exchange for gold. The Master sends a celestial warrior down to set them free.

games.title: Dragon Warrior I & II
games.description: Remakes of the first two Dragon Quest games in one package, with updated graphics and smoother pacing. First you play Erdrick's lone descendant against the Dragonlord. Then, a century later, a trio of royal heirs fights the wizard Hargon.

games.title: Illusion of Gaia
games.description: An action RPG with no grinding: your strength grows as you clear each area, and you can transform into the dark knight Freedan and the warrior Shadow. As a comet approaches the Earth, Will, a boy with telekinetic powers, travels through versions of real ancient wonders such as the Incan ruins, the Great Wall, Angkor Wat and the pyramids.

games.title: Ogre Battle: The March of the Black Queen
games.description: A real-time strategy game with RPG character growth: you move squads around the map, and their battles play out automatically based on formation and tactics. Twenty-five years after the Zetegenian Empire conquered the continent, a rebel leader rises against the Empress Endora. Your choices and reputation decide which of many endings you reach.

releases.listed_title: Ogre Battle: The March of the Black Queen

games.title: Paladin's Quest
games.description: A turn-based RPG where spells cost hit points instead of magic points, and you can hire mercenaries to fill out your party. Chezni, a student at a magic school, opens a forbidden door on a dare and wakes Dal Gren, an ancient war machine. After it kills his teacher, he sets out across the world of Lennus to stop it.

games.title: Romancing SaGa 2
games.description: A generational RPG where the crown passes from emperor to emperor over centuries, each inheriting the last one's techniques. The empire of Avalon fights to defeat the Seven Heroes, legendary saviors who have returned as conquerors.

games.title: Secret of Mana
games.description: An action RPG with real-time combat, a ring-shaped menu and three-player co-op. Randi, a boy from the village of Potos, pulls a rusted sword from a stone and is banished; with Primm and the sprite Popoi, he must restore the Mana Sword before an empire revives the Mana Fortress.

games.title: The 7th Saga
games.description: A turn-based RPG where you play one of seven apprentices, and the other six roam the world as rivals or possible partners. King Lemele sends his seven apprentices to find seven magic runes that grant the power to rule. The race turns violent, and a darker threat is waiting behind it.

games.title: Brain Lord
games.description: An action RPG built around puzzle-filled dungeons, with small creatures called jades fighting at your side. Remeer, a descendant of the Dragonbloods, sets out to find his father, who vanished while exploring a tower where an evil force is stirring.

games.title: Final Fantasy VI
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a large ensemble cast, each with a unique battle skill, and magic learned from espers. Terra, a young woman with a mysterious gift for magic, escapes the Gestahlian Empire's control and joins the Returners rebellion, while the court mage Kefka schemes to seize the espers' power.

games.title: Live A Live
games.description: A turn-based RPG with grid battles, made of seven short chapters set in different eras and styles, from prehistory to the far future. Seven heroes, including a caveman, a ninja, a kung fu master and a robot, face their own trials before their stories come together.

games.title: Robotrek
games.description: A turn-based RPG where you invent, program and upgrade robots that fight for you, building their parts in your own lab. The young son of the inventor Dr. Akihabara must stop the Hackers, a gang searching for a legendary power source.

games.title: Chrono Trigger
games.description: A turn-based RPG with combination 'techs' between party members, battles on the field map and many endings. Crono and his friends travel through time from prehistory to a ruined future after learning that a creature called Lavos will destroy the world in 1999.

games.title: Dragon Quest VI
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a flexible job system and a story split between two parallel worlds. After a failed attack on the demon lord Murdaw, a young hero wakes up in a village and discovers there is a real world and a dream world. Somewhere between them, he has lost part of himself.

games.title: Front Mission
games.description: A turn-based tactical RPG where you customize mechs called wanzers part by part. On Huffman Island, contested by two superpowers, the soldier Lloyd Clive sees his fiancée killed in a staged incident, and joins a mercenary unit to find out who was responsible.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Mahoujin GuruGuru
games.description: A role-playing game based on Hiroyuki Etō's comedy manga, which pokes fun at Dragon Quest-style RPGs. The cowardly would-be hero Nike teams up with Kukuri, the last of the Migu Migu tribe, who casts Guru Guru magic by drawing circles on the ground. Together they set out to defeat the demon lord Giri, who has broken free after 300 years.

games.title: Mystic Ark
games.description: A turn-based RPG built like an anthology, where each world has its own story and cast. The hero, Remeer or Ferris, wakes in a temple on an unknown island. The only way home is to collect the arks hidden in other worlds, which are reached through figurines inside the temple. It's a spiritual successor to The 7th Saga.

games.title: Nekketsu Tairiku Burning Heroes
games.description: A turn-based RPG where taking damage fills a passion meter that lets you summon a powerful monster against the whole enemy party. You choose among four heroes with separate goals. Ryu wants to surpass the father who cast him out, Laila wants treasure and adventure, Gaou searches for his missing love Asuka, and Naaga has to pay off a huge debt to her guild. Their paths cross and turn out to lead to the same goal.

games.title: Romancing SaGa 3
games.description: A nonlinear RPG with eight protagonists, freely recruitable companions and a large-scale battle mode. Every 300 years a Death Eclipse kills every newborn child, but one baby born during the last eclipse survived, and the heroes are drawn into the mystery of what that child means for the world.

games.title: Tactics Ogre
games.description: A tactical RPG with grid battles and a branching story shaped by hard moral choices. On the Valerian Isles, three ethnic factions fight a civil war after their king's death, and young Denam Pavel joins a resistance that forces him to decide how far he will go for his people.

games.title: Terranigma
games.description: An action RPG that starts underground and has you bring the surface world back to life: first the continents, then plants and animals, and finally humanity, whose cities grow as the game goes on. Ark, a mischievous boy from the village of Crysta, opens a forbidden door and frees a strange being called Yomi. He must restore the world above to undo the damage.

games.title: Trials of Mana
games.description: An action RPG where you pick three of six heroes, and your choice changes the story and the final villain. As the Mana Tree withers, the heroes travel to the eight Mana Stones in search of the Sword of Mana, racing dark forces who want its power for themselves.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

sources: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Dark Half
games.description: A turn-based RPG told from both sides, switching between the villain and the hero. Each starts the day with Soul Power that drains with every step, so time is always running out. A thousand years after Saint Rhoda and six Paladins sealed away the evil Rukyu, the mercenary Falco finds him breaking free. You play both Rukyu's campaign to end humanity and Falco's fight to stop him.

games.title: Mahoujin GuruGuru 2
games.description: An action RPG sequel based on the same comedy manga, which pokes fun at RPG habits like endless side quests and turn-based combat. Nike and his magician partner Kukuri continue their hunt for the demon lord Giri to end his cruel rule.

games.title: Star Ocean
games.description: A real-time action RPG with a large cast of recruitable characters and a 'private actions' system that builds relationships and changes the ending. When a plague turns the people of Kratus to stone, the young swordsman Roddick meets a crew from the Earth Federation. They take him 300 years into the past to find a cure.

games.title: Final Fantasy Tactics
games.description: A tactical RPG with grid battles and a job system of more than 20 classes. In Ivalice, torn by the War of the Lions between two noble houses, the young knight Ramza Beoulve uncovers a conspiracy within the church, while his childhood friend Delita climbs to power by his own means.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII
games.description: A turn-based RPG with Active Time Battles and materia, gems slotted into equipment to grant magic and skills. Cloud Strife, a former soldier turned mercenary, joins the eco-terrorist group AVALANCHE against the Shinra corporation, which is draining the planet's life, and is drawn into a hunt for the legendary Sephiroth.

games.title: SaGa Frontier
games.description: A nonlinear RPG in a sci-fi fantasy setting, with seven protagonists who each have their own storyline across worlds called the Regions. The heroes include a girl turned half-mystic, a combat robot, a superhero and a young magician born without magic.

games.title: Dragon Warrior Monsters
games.description: A monster-collecting RPG: recruit monsters, train them, and breed pairs to create stronger ones. When young Terry's sister Milly is taken to the kingdom of GreatTree, he becomes a monster master and fights his way through the kingdom's tournament to get her back.

games.title: Star Ocean: The Second Story
games.description: A real-time action RPG with two playable heroes, item crafting and dozens of endings shaped by your relationships. Claude, the son of a Federation admiral, is accidentally teleported to the planet Expel. The villager Rena takes him for a legendary warrior just as a mysterious meteorite called the Sorcery Globe fills the land with monsters.

games.title: Chrono Cross
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a stamina-based battle system, element grids and more than 40 recruitable characters. Serge, a boy from a fishing village in El Nido, slips into a parallel world where he drowned ten years earlier, and must cross between the two worlds to learn why.

games.title: Final Fantasy VIII
games.description: A turn-based RPG where you draw magic from enemies, junction it to your stats and summon Guardian Forces. Squall Leonhart, a cadet at the mercenary academy Balamb Garden, joins the elite SeeD and is drawn into a conflict with a sorceress who threatens to compress all of time.

games.title: Legend of Mana
games.description: An action RPG where you build the map yourself by placing artifacts that become towns and dungeons, with dozens of short, mostly separate stories. A hero arrives in Fa'Diel, a land whose regions were sealed away after the Mana Tree burned, and brings it back piece by piece.

games.title: Mystic Ark: Maboroshi Gekijou
games.description: A 3D adventure game with action battles, where you progress by using the right items in the right places rather than by leveling up. A troupe of traveling actors comes to a quiet port town during its anniversary. When a child sneaks into their theater one night, the strange Mr. Silverfingertips sends them on a journey into the land of the fairies to solve a mystery.

games.title: SaGa Frontier 2
games.description: A turn-based RPG told in watercolor art across two parallel stories spanning decades. In the land of Sandail, Gustave XIII is exiled because he lacks anima, the magic in all living things, and fights his way to power, while the digger Wil Knights and his descendants hunt for mysterious relics called Quells.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Torneko: The Last Hope
games.description: A roguelike dungeon crawler: every floor is randomly generated, each step is a turn, and if you fall you return to town without the items you were carrying. Torneko, the cheerful merchant from Dragon Quest IV, ventures into mysterious dungeons in search of treasure to stock his shop.

games.title: Valkyrie Profile
games.description: A turn-based RPG with combo-based battles, side-scrolling dungeons and a deadline that ticks down by chapters. As Ragnarok approaches, the Valkyrie Lenneth is sent to the human world to gather the souls of fallen warriors. She trains them and sends them to fight for the gods in Asgard.

games.title: Blade Arts: Tasogare no Miyako R'lyeh
games.description: A third-person hack-and-slash action game with a lock-on system for fighting groups of enemies at once. After an earthquake in the South Pacific, a team of scientists disappears on the mysterious volcanic island of Seiremu. The hero takes up oversized magic weapons to explore its ancient ruins and find out what happened.

releases.listed_title: Blade Arts: Tasogare no Miyako R'lyeh

games.title: Dragon Quest VII
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a deep class system and a very long story told island by island. On Estard, which the young hero believes is the only land in the world, he and Prince Kiefer find stone tablet fragments that carry them into the past. There they save lost islands and bring them back into the present.

games.title: Final Fantasy IX
games.description: A turn-based RPG in a classic fantasy style, with abilities learned from equipment and four-member parties. Zidane, a thief in a theater troupe, plans to kidnap Princess Garnet of Alexandria, only to find she wants to escape, and the two are drawn into a war stirred up by the mysterious Kuja.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

sources: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Cross Gate
games.description: An online multiplayer RPG with turn-based, Dragon Quest-style battles for parties of up to five players. It offers more than 60 jobs and creatures you can raise and bring into battle. It's built around adventuring with other players, and English sources don't describe its story.

games.title: Depth Fantasia
games.description: An online RPG for parties of up to four, played online or solo, with chain attacks between party members and Life Gems that power up characters and weapons. On Ritos Island, a demon attacks a village and is defeated by a villager holding a legendary Life Gem. More demons soon appear, and the Kingdom of Daros wants the stone. You travel from Daros to the island to fight the demons and search for the gems.

games.title: Dragon Warrior Monsters 2: Cobi's Journey
games.description: A monster-collecting RPG with expanded breeding, sold in two versions with different monsters. Cobi's family moves to the island kingdom of GreatLog, which is slowly sinking into the sea. Cobi becomes a monster master and travels through other worlds to save it. Tara's Adventure tells the same story through his sister.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Monsters 2: Iru and Luca's Marvelous Mysterious Key

games.title: Dragon Warrior Monsters 2: Tara's Adventure
games.description: The companion version to Cobi's Journey, with the same monster-collecting and breeding RPG but a different set of monsters. Tara, Cobi's sister, becomes a monster master and travels through other worlds to save the slowly sinking island kingdom of GreatLog.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Monsters 2: Iru and Luca's Marvelous Mysterious Key

games.title: Final Fantasy X
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a battle system that lets you swap party members mid-fight, and a Sphere Grid for character growth. Tidus, a star of the underwater sport blitzball, is pulled from his city by a monster called Sin into the world of Spira, where he guards the summoner Yuna on her pilgrimage to defeat it.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Star Ocean: Blue Sphere
games.description: A real-time action RPG for Game Boy Color and a direct sequel to Star Ocean: The Second Story. Two years after the events on Expel, Claude, Rena and their friends head to a new planet to investigate a mysterious phenomenon.

games.title: Dragon Quest Characters: Torneko no Daibōken 3
games.description: A roguelike dungeon crawler in full 3D, with randomly generated dungeons, turn-based combat and allies and monsters you can bring along. The merchant Torneko, his wife and their son Tipper take a trip to a distant island to celebrate Tipper's birthday. Trouble strands them on a strange island, and Torneko must head into its dungeons to fight off the forces attacking it.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Characters: Torneko no Daibōken 3
Dragon Quest Characters: Torneko no Daibōken 3 Advance

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters 1+2
games.description: A PlayStation collection of the Game Boy monster-collecting RPGs, with improved graphics and extra scenarios. It includes Terry's quest through GreatTree and both versions of the story of the sinking island kingdom of GreatLog.

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters i
games.description: A Dragon Quest Monsters game for Japanese i-mode mobile phones, which could receive monsters uploaded from the PlayStation collection Dragon Quest Monsters 1+2. It brings the series' recruit-and-breed formula to phones. English sources don't describe its story.

games.title: Final Fantasy XI
games.description: An online multiplayer RPG set in the world of Vana'diel, where players choose a race, pick from many jobs and form parties for missions. Players serve one of three rival nations, which must set old grudges aside as the Shadow Lord's beastmen armies return.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Grandia II
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a real-time timeline battle system that lets you interrupt enemy attacks. Ryudo, a cynical mercenary, takes a job escorting Elena, a songstress of the Church of Granas. He gets caught up in the return of Valmar, the god of darkness.

games.title: Grandia Xtreme
games.description: A dungeon-focused RPG that keeps Grandia's timeline battles and puts long expeditions ahead of story. Evann, a young ranger, is recruited to explore unstable elemental dungeons that have appeared after a disaster.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts
games.description: An action RPG that blends Disney worlds with Final Fantasy characters. Sora, a boy from the Destiny Islands, is separated from his friends Riku and Kairi when creatures called the Heartless swallow his home, and he teams up with Donald and Goofy to find them and seal the hearts of worlds.

releases.source: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

sources: general knowledge (original release; not on the Wikipedia lists)

games.title: Samurai Evolution: Oukoku Geist
games.description: An RPG where you recruit creatures that turn into weapons, such as swords, axes and claws, each with its own element, while the hero does all the fighting in side-scrolling battles. It's set in a futuristic Japan of bionic samurai and supercomputer cherry trees. Fifteen years after a brief war with a hidden alien realm, the country has become the Cherry Blossom Kingdom, obsessed with dueling. You play as Masamune or his sister Kaguya.

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: Caravan Heart
games.description: A monster-collecting RPG where you lead a traveling caravan, recruiting monsters and people to defend it and combining monster hearts to transform your creatures. Prince Kiefer from Dragon Quest VII is pulled into the world of Dragon Quest II after a masked figure offers him a wish in exchange for the Orbs of Loto. There he leads the caravan of Luin, a young leader seeking a cure for his sick parents.

games.title: Drakengard
games.description: A hack-and-slash action RPG with ground battles against huge armies and aerial dragon combat. The prince Caim, mortally wounded while defending his sister Furiae from the Empire, forms a pact with a red dragon, losing his voice but gaining the strength to fight on.

games.title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles
games.description: An action RPG built for co-op play, where the party carries a chalice that protects them from a poisonous miasma. Every year, caravans from villages sheltered by crystals must travel to collect myrrh, which renews the crystals, or their towns will be swallowed by the miasma.

games.title: Final Fantasy X-2
games.description: A fast Active Time Battle RPG with a dressphere system that switches jobs mid-battle, and a mission-based structure. Two years after Sin's defeat, Yuna becomes a treasure hunter with the Gullwings, chasing a sphere that may show that Tidus is still alive.

games.title: Front Mission 4
games.description: A tactical RPG with customizable wanzer mechs and a link system that lets units back up each other's attacks. In 2020, Elsa, a new member of a European research unit called Durandal, investigates attacks on German bases, while a Venezuelan soldier named Darril follows a trail of stolen gold.

games.title: Fullmetal Alchemist and the Broken Angel
games.description: An action RPG based on the Fullmetal Alchemist manga, with real-time combat and alchemy that turns the scenery into weapons. The alchemist brothers Edward and Alphonse Elric, searching for the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies, follow a new lead in an original story written for the game.

releases.listed_title: Fullmetal Alchemist and the Broken Angel

games.title: Star Ocean: Till the End of Time
games.description: A real-time action RPG with fully 3D battles, item crafting and a story that spans several planets. While on vacation with his family on a resort planet, Fayt Leingod is caught in an attack and escapes to an underdeveloped world. He searches for his missing father while war spreads across the galaxy.

releases.listed_title: Star Ocean: Till the End of Time

games.title: Sword of Mana
games.description: An action RPG that reimagines Final Fantasy Adventure, with separate stories for a hero and a heroine. The hero, a former gladiator, seeks revenge on the Dark Lord who killed his family, while the heroine, a descendant of the Mana clan, tries to protect the Mana Tree.

games.title: Dragon Quest VIII
games.description: A turn-based RPG with the series' first fully 3D world, a tension system for charging up attacks, and an alchemy pot for crafting. The jester Dhoulmagus steals a magic sceptre and curses the kingdom of Trodain, turning King Trode into a toad-like monster and Princess Medea into a horse, and a castle guard sets out with them to break the curse.

games.title: Fullmetal Alchemist 2: Curse of the Crimson Elixir
games.description: An action RPG sequel based on Fullmetal Alchemist, with combo-based combat and alchemy. The Elric brothers continue their search for the Philosopher's Stone and follow rumors of a mysterious red elixir in another original story.

releases.listed_title: Fullmetal Alchemist 2: Curse of the Crimson Elixir

games.title: Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories
games.description: An action RPG with card-based combat, where attacks, magic and items are played from a deck. Sora, Donald and Goofy enter Castle Oblivion, where each floor rebuilt from Sora's memories costs him more of them, while members of Organization XIII pull the strings.

games.title: Code Age Commanders
games.description: A Japan-only action RPG where you control one character on missions against enemies called the Coded, while keeping computer-controlled allies alive. It's set in a hollow world like a Dyson sphere, where a recurring disaster called the Reborn wipes out life, and follows four successive heroes.

games.title: Drakengard 2
games.description: A hack-and-slash action RPG with ground and dragon combat, set 18 years after the first game. Nowe, a young man raised by the dragon Legna, serves the Knights of the Seal, who guard the seals that hold the world together, until he learns the cost of keeping them.

games.title: Egg Monster Hero
games.description: A Japan-only RPG for the Nintendo DS. Katori Island has been conquered by an evil hard-boiled army and renamed Hard-Boiled Island, and a young master must defeat the army and its leader, the Great Hard-Boiled Devil.

games.title: Front Mission 5: Scars of the War
games.description: A tactical RPG with wanzer customization and a story that spans decades of the series' timeline. Walter Feng, a soldier who grew up on contested Huffman Island, follows his career from childhood through the series' major wars as the mystery behind a shadowy military unit unfolds.

releases.listed_title: Front Mission 5: Scars of the War

games.title: Fullmetal Alchemist 3: Kami o Tsugu Shōjo
games.description: A Japan-only action RPG based on Fullmetal Alchemist. Its title means 'The Girl Who Succeeds God', and the Elric brothers' search for the Philosopher's Stone crosses paths with that girl in an original story.

releases.listed_title: Fullmetal Alchemist 3: Kami o Tsugu Shōjo

games.title: Grandia III
games.description: A turn-based RPG with Grandia's timeline battle system and aerial combos. Yuki, a boy who dreams of becoming a pilot, crashes on his first flight and meets Alfina, a Communicator who can speak with guardian spirits, and joins her on her journey.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts II
games.description: An action RPG with Drive Forms that fuse Sora with his companions, and reaction commands in battle. A year after the first game, Sora wakes from a long sleep and resumes his search for Riku and King Mickey, now facing the black-coated Organization XIII. It opens with the mysterious boy Roxas in Twilight Town.

games.title: Musashi: Samurai Legend
games.description: An action RPG with two-sword combat and the ability to steal enemies' techniques. The young swordsman Musashi is summoned to the world of Anthem to rescue Princess Mycella from the Gandrake Corporation, a power company draining the world's energy.

games.title: Radiata Stories
games.description: A real-time action RPG with more than 170 recruitable characters, each with their own daily routine. Jack Russell, an eager young swordsman, joins the knights of the Kingdom of Radiata and is drawn into a war between humans and non-humans that forces him to choose a side.

games.title: Children of Mana
games.description: A dungeon-crawling action RPG with four-player co-op. Years after a great disaster, one of four young heroes from Illusia Isle, home of the Mana Tree, sets out to protect the world as monsters and calamities return.

games.title: Dawn of Mana
games.description: A 3D action-adventure with RPG growth and physics-based combat where you throw objects and enemies around. Keldric, a young man from the island of Illusia, must protect the Tree of Mana after soldiers from the kingdom of Lorimar invade.

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker
games.description: The first 3D monster-collecting RPG in the series, with scouting and monster synthesis. A young monster scout competes in a tournament held across a chain of islands, and uncovers a mystery behind a dark substance that is corrupting monsters.

games.title: Dragon Quest: Young Yangus and the Mystery Dungeon
games.description: A roguelike dungeon crawler where you recruit monsters to fight beside you. Yangus, the bandit from Dragon Quest VIII, as a young boy, gets sucked into a magic pot and lands on an island of monsters, where he must climb its dungeons to find a way home.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest: Young Yangus and the Mystery Dungeon

games.title: Fantasy Earth: Zero
games.description: An online action RPG built around large-scale wars, with dozens of players fighting on each side for rival nations. Players pick a class and join one of several kingdoms competing for territory across the continent.

games.title: Final Fantasy XII
games.description: An RPG with seamless real-time battles run through gambits, programmable orders for each party member. In Ivalice, the street orphan Vaan joins sky pirates and the deposed Princess Ashe in a resistance against the Archadian Empire, which has conquered her kingdom of Dalmasca.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy XII International Zodiac Job System
Final Fantasy XII: The Zodiac Age

games.title: Valkyrie Profile 2: Silmeria
games.description: A turn-based RPG with combo battles and side-scrolling dungeons, set centuries before Valkyrie Profile. Princess Alicia of Dipan shares her body with the Valkyrie Silmeria, who rebelled against Odin, and the two flee the gods' wrath together.

games.title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII
games.description: An action RPG prequel to Final Fantasy VII with real-time battles and a slot-machine wheel that triggers special abilities. Zack Fair, a cheerful member of Shinra's elite SOLDIER, is sent after a missing SOLDIER named Genesis and learns dark truths alongside his mentor Angeal and Sephiroth.

releases.listed_title: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII Reunion

games.title: Dragon Quest Swords: The Masked Queen and the Tower of Mirrors
games.description: A first-person action RPG on rails where you swing the Wii Remote like a sword and raise a shield to block. The young hero of Avalonia sets out on his coming-of-age journey and faces the Masked Queen and a tower of mirrors that hold monsters.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Swords: The Masked Queen and the Tower of Mirrors

games.title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Ring of Fates
games.description: An action RPG with co-op play and a story mode on the DS. The twins Yuri and Chelinka live a quiet life with their father until a mysterious man attacks their village, and the two set out on a journey tied to the power of the crystals.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Ring of Fates

games.title: Final Fantasy Fables: Chocobo's Dungeon
games.description: A roguelike dungeon crawler with randomly generated floors and a job system. When a bell's toll wipes the memories of everyone in the town of Lostime, the series' bird-riding hero dives into dungeons built from those memories to bring them back.

releases.listed_title: Cid to Chocobo no Fushigi na Dungeon Toki Wasure no Meikyū DS+

games.title: Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift
games.description: A tactical RPG with grid battles, clans and a job system. Luso, a boy stuck in detention, opens a mysterious book in the school library and is pulled into Ivalice, where he joins a clan of adventurers while searching for a way home.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy Tactics A2: Grimoire of the Rift

games.title: Final Fantasy XII: Revenant Wings
games.description: A real-time strategy RPG where you lead your party and command summoned creatures called yarhi. A year after Final Fantasy XII, Vaan and Penelo, now sky pirates, travel to the floating continent of Lemurés and face the Judge of Wings.

games.title: The World Ends with You
games.description: An action RPG with a split-screen battle system, where pins cast psychic attacks, set in Tokyo's Shibuya district. Neku wakes up in the street with no memory of how he got there, and learns he is one of the dead playing the Reapers' Game, a seven-day contest for a second chance at life.

releases.listed_title: The World Ends with You: Final Remix

games.title: Dissidia Final Fantasy
games.description: A fighting game with RPG growth, where heroes and villains from Final Fantasy I to X level up and equip gear between one-on-one battles. Cosmos, goddess of harmony, and Chaos, god of discord, summon warriors from many worlds to fight in their endless war.

games.title: Front Mission 2089: Border of Madness
games.description: A Japan-only tactical RPG for the DS set in the year 2089, with turn-based battles between customizable wanzer mechs.

games.title: Infinite Undiscovery
games.description: A real-time action RPG where party members fight on their own and you link with them for combined attacks. Capell, a flute player, is mistaken for the hero Sigmund, who leads a rebellion against the Order of the Chains, which has bound the moon to the world with giant chains.

games.title: Sigma Harmonics
games.description: A Japan-only mystery RPG for the DS that mixes detective work with battles. Sigma, heir to a family that guards the flow of time, and his partner Neon travel into the past to solve a series of murders and set history right.

games.title: The Last Remnant
games.description: An RPG with large squad-based battles, where you command groups of fighters instead of individuals. Rush Sykes searches for his kidnapped sister Irina in a world where ancient artifacts called Remnants give their owners great power.

games.title: Valkyrie Profile: Covenant of the Plume
games.description: A tactical RPG where you can sacrifice allies with the Plume of Hel to gain power. Wylfred, whose father died in battle and was taken by the Valkyrie, swears revenge on her and makes a pact with the goddess Hel.

releases.listed_title: Valkyrie Profile: Covenant of the Plume

games.title: Blood of Bahamut
games.description: A Japan-only multiplayer action RPG for the DS, where players climb onto colossal creatures and attack them as a team. Its battles are built around taking on giants far larger than the heroes.

games.title: Cross Treasures
games.description: A Japan-only RPG for the DS with co-op dungeon crawling, island building and four classes that branch into advanced ones. A huge dungeon releases monsters on a peaceful island kingdom, an evil lord kidnaps the princess, and the hero must rescue her and restore peace.

games.title: Dragon Quest IX
games.description: A turn-based RPG with four-player local co-op, a job system and equipment that shows on your character. A Celestrian, a guardian angel watching over a village, falls to the human world when a great force attacks the Observatory, and searches for the fruit of the World Tree to return home.

games.title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time
games.description: An action RPG with co-op play between the DS and Wii versions. A young hero from a forest village sets out to find a cure for a girl stricken with crystal sickness, and learns of a lost civilization that relied on crystals.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: Echoes of Time

games.title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: The Crystal Bearers
games.description: An action-adventure with RPG elements, where the hero uses gravity powers to pick up and throw enemies and objects. Layle, a crystal bearer with rare powers, works as a mercenary in the Lilty kingdom and is drawn into a plot involving the long-vanished Yuke tribe.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy Crystal Chronicles: The Crystal Bearers

games.title: Final Fantasy IV: The After Years
games.description: A turn-based RPG sequel told in episodic chapters, with a moon-phase system that changes the strength of attacks and magic. Seventeen years after Final Fantasy IV, Cecil's son Ceodore faces a mysterious girl who is taking crystals around the world as a second moon appears in the sky.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy IV: The After Years
Final Fantasy IV: The Complete Collection

games.title: Final Fantasy XIII
games.description: A fast Active Time Battle RPG with paradigm shifts that change party roles mid-fight. In the floating world of Cocoon, the soldier Lightning and a group of strangers are branded l'Cie by a god-like fal'Cie from Pulse, the feared world below, and must fight their own government.

games.title: Final Fantasy: The 4 Heroes of Light
games.description: A turn-based RPG with a crown system that grants jobs, and action points instead of magic points. On his fourteenth birthday, Brandt is sent by his king to rescue a kidnapped princess, and three other young people join him on a journey that grows into a fight for the world.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy: The 4 Heroes of Light

games.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Daughter of the Dusk
games.description: A Japan-only action RPG for the Wii and the second half of the story begun in Prince of the Dawn, with motion-controlled combat and alchemy starring the Elric brothers.

releases.listed_title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Daughter of the Dusk

games.title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Prince of the Dawn
games.description: A Japan-only action RPG for the Wii based on Fullmetal Alchemist, using motion controls for combat and alchemy. It tells the first half of an original two-part story starring the Elric brothers.

releases.listed_title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Prince of the Dawn

games.title: Gyromancer
games.description: A puzzle RPG that mixes gem-rotating puzzle battles with summoned beasts that grow stronger. Rivel, a Gyromancer who commands beasts, journeys through a forest kingdom on a dangerous mission.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days
games.description: An action RPG built around daily missions, with co-op play for up to four. Roxas, a new member of Organization XIII with no memory of his past, collects hearts for the Organization alongside his friends Axel and Xion, while questioning who he really is.

games.title: Star Ocean: The Last Hope
games.description: A real-time action RPG with Blindside counterattacks and crafting, and a prequel to the rest of the series. After World War III leaves Earth uninhabitable, Edge Maverick joins the first crew of the Space Reconnaissance Force, searching the stars for a new home for humanity.

releases.listed_title: Star Ocean: The Last Hope International
Star Ocean: The Last Hope 4K & Full HD Remaster

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 2
games.description: A monster-collecting RPG with giant monsters that fill several party slots, and online battles. A boy stows away on an airship bound for a monster-scout tournament, and when it crashes on an unknown island, he must recruit monsters to survive and find a way off.

games.title: Final Fantasy XIV
games.description: An online multiplayer RPG where one character can learn every job, set in the realm of Eorzea. The original 2010 version ended with the Calamity, when the moon Dalamud fell; A Realm Reborn picks up five years later as adventurers face primals and the invading Garlean Empire.

releases.listed_title: Final Fantasy XIV: A Realm Reborn

games.title: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep
games.description: An action RPG with a deck of commands that combine into new abilities, told through three heroes' stories. Ten years before the first game, the apprentices Terra, Aqua and Ventus take their Mark of Mastery exam, and their master's old rival, the sinister Master Xehanort, sends them across worlds.

releases.listed_title: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix

games.title: Kingdom Hearts Re:coded
games.description: An action RPG where a digital version of Sora fixes glitches inside worlds made of data. A mysterious message appears in Jiminy Cricket's journal of Sora's travels, and King Mickey creates a data copy of Sora to explore the journal's corrupted worlds.

games.title: Lord of Arcana
games.description: A hunting-focused action RPG with co-op play, where you take on huge monsters for the materials they drop. Warriors come to a monster-filled land to compete for the Arcana, a legendary source of power.

games.title: Lufia: Curse of the Sinistrals
games.description: An action RPG remake of Lufia II, with real-time combat and puzzle-filled dungeons. Maxim, a young swordsman, is drawn into a war against the Sinistrals, four god-like beings bent on conquering humanity.

games.title: Nier
games.description: An action RPG that mixes hack-and-slash with spellcasting, shooter sections and other genre shifts. In a far future of crumbling villages, a man searches for a cure for Yonah, who suffers from the Black Scrawl, fighting shadowy creatures with the help of a talking book.

games.title: Dissidia 012 Final Fantasy
games.description: A prequel to Dissidia Final Fantasy that adds new fighters, assist attacks and an overworld map between battles. It tells the twelfth cycle of the war between Cosmos and Chaos, with warriors such as Lightning and Kain joining the fight.

games.title: Dungeon Siege III
games.description: A real-time action RPG with co-op play and a story centered on a few heroes. The kingdom of Ehb has turned against the 10th Legion, its old protectors, and the Legion's last heirs must rebuild it and face the zealot Jeyne Kassynder.

games.title: Final Fantasy Type-0
games.description: An action RPG with fourteen playable cadets and a darker, war-focused story. When the Militesi Empire invades the Dominion of Rubrum, the elite Class Zero of the magic academy Akademeia fights back and uncovers the truth behind the crystals that empower each nation.

games.title: Final Fantasy XIII-2
games.description: A fast Active Time Battle RPG with recruitable monsters and time travel through branching eras. Three years after Final Fantasy XIII, Serah Farron and Noel, a young man from the far future, travel through time to find Lightning and fix the paradoxes changing history.

games.title: Lord of Apocalypse
games.description: A Japan-only hunting-focused action RPG and sequel to Lord of Arcana, with co-op battles against huge monsters.

games.title: Bravely Default
games.description: A turn-based RPG where you can bank turns with Default or borrow them with Brave, plus a deep job system. Tiz, the only survivor when his village falls into a chasm, joins Agnès, the vestal of wind, on a quest to restore the four crystals of Luxendarc.

games.title: Dragon Quest X
games.description: An online multiplayer RPG with command-based battles that play out in real time. The hero is murdered in his village and reborn as a member of another race in the world of Astoltia, where he searches for his lost sibling and the truth behind the attack.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance
games.description: An action RPG where you switch between two heroes as you 'drop' from one story to the other, with dream-eater companions. Sora and Riku take the Mark of Mastery exam in the sleeping worlds, but the test is a trap set by Master Xehanort.

releases.listed_title: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue

games.title: Wakfu
games.description: A turn-based tactical online RPG set in the World of Twelve, where players' choices shape its ecosystem and politics. Players pick one of a dozen classes and help rebuild a world flooded by the tears of the giant Ogrest.

games.title: Chaos Rings
games.description: A turn-based RPG where pairs of fighters battle side by side. Five couples are brought to a place called the Ark Arena and forced into a tournament in which only the winning pair survives and earns eternal life.

games.title: Drakengard 3
games.description: A hack-and-slash action RPG with dragon battles, and a prequel to the first game. Zero, one of six singers called Intoners who wield magic through song, sets out with her dragon Mikhail to kill her five sisters.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts χ
games.description: A browser action RPG with card-based combat, set in the age of fairy tales long before the main series. Players are young Keyblade wielders who join one of five Unions and gather light to fight the darkness as a great Keyblade War approaches.

games.title: Lightning Returns: Final Fantasy XIII
games.description: An action RPG with real-time battles, swappable outfits called schemata and a countdown to the end of the world. Lightning wakes 500 years after Final Fantasy XIII-2 with 13 days left before the world ends, chosen by the god Bhunivelze to save as many souls as she can.

games.title: Chaos Rings III
games.description: A turn-based RPG with three-person parties, where resting members still earn some experience. Adventurers gather in the coastal city of Neo Paleo to become Explorers and make the pilgrimage to the planet Marble Blue, where the hero learns the truth behind 'Paradise'.

games.title: Final Fantasy Explorers
games.description: A hunting-focused action RPG with four-player co-op and a job system. Explorers travel to the island of Amostra to hunt its eidolons, the summoned beasts that guard the Grand Crystal, a vast source of crystal power.

games.title: Bravely Second: End Layer
games.description: A turn-based RPG sequel with Brave and Default turns and new jobs. Two and a half years after Bravely Default, Agnès is kidnapped by the Kaiser Oblivion, and her bodyguard Yew Geneolgia sets out to rescue her.

games.title: Dragon Quest Heroes: The World Tree's Woe and the Blight Below
games.description: A hack-and-slash action RPG where Dragon Quest heroes fight huge crowds of monsters. In the kingdom of Arba, monsters that lived peacefully with humans suddenly turn hostile, and the royal captains Luceus and Aurora lead the fight to find out why.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Heroes: The World Tree's Woe and the Blight Below

games.title: Imperial SaGa
games.description: A Japan-only browser RPG that gathers characters from across the SaGa series into turn-based battles led by an emperor.

games.title: Rise of Mana
games.description: A Japan-only action RPG for the PS Vita, adapted from a free-to-play mobile game. Players take the role of a being from heaven or the underworld who loses their power and falls into the world of the Mana Tree.

games.title: Dragon Quest Builders
games.description: A sandbox action RPG where you gather materials and build towns block by block. In an alternate history where the hero of the first Dragon Quest accepted the Dragonlord's offer, Alefgard lies in ruins, and a young builder must bring back the lost art of building.

games.title: Dragon Quest Heroes II
games.description: A hack-and-slash action RPG with online co-op and a bigger world. The cousins Lazarel and Teresa are training soldiers in the Seven Realms, which have been at peace for a thousand years until war suddenly breaks out, and they set out to learn who started it.

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: Joker 3
games.description: A monster-collecting RPG where you can ride your monsters to explore, with deeper monster synthesis. A young monster scout travels across new lands, recruiting and riding monsters as a dark threat spreads.

games.title: Final Fantasy XV
games.description: An open-world action RPG built around a road trip, with real-time combat and warp attacks. Prince Noctis of Lucis sets out with three friends for his wedding, but the Empire of Niflheim seizes his kingdom's crystal during a peace treaty, and Noctis must reclaim his throne.

releases.developer: Square Enix / HexaDrive / XPEC Entertainment / Luminous Productions

games.title: I Am Setsuna
games.description: A turn-based RPG inspired by 1990s classics, with Active Time Battles and timed Momentum attacks. Endir, a masked mercenary, is hired to kill Setsuna, a young woman chosen to be sacrificed to calm the island's monsters, but instead guards her on her pilgrimage.

games.title: Mobius Final Fantasy
games.description: An RPG with job cards and element-based turn battles. Wol wakes up with no memory in the world of Palamecia, where people wait for a prophesied Warrior of Light to save them from chaos.

games.title: SaGa: Scarlet Grace
games.description: A nonlinear turn-based RPG with a timeline battle system and four protagonists. A thousand years after the fall of the Firebringer, the empire that once ruled the land has collapsed, and four heroes set out on separate journeys across the fractured world.

games.title: Star Ocean: Integrity and Faithlessness
games.description: A real-time action RPG with seamless battles involving up to seven party members at once. Fidel, a swordsman from the planet Faykreed, finds a mysterious girl named Relia with no memories, and gets caught up in a conflict between his world and visitors from space.

games.title: World of Final Fantasy
games.description: A turn-based RPG where you capture monsters called Mirages and stack them into towers that pool their abilities. The twins Lann and Reynn wake with no memories in the world of Grymoire and must rebuild their power as Mirage Keepers, meeting tiny versions of Final Fantasy heroes along the way.

games.title: Dragon Quest XI
games.description: A turn-based RPG in classic Dragon Quest style, with pep-powered combination moves and the large world of Erdrea. On his sixteenth birthday, a young man learns he is the reincarnated Luminary, a legendary hero, but the king of Heliodor brands him the Darkspawn and hunts him across the land.

games.title: Lost Sphear
games.description: A turn-based RPG with Active Time Battles and the power to restore lost places through memories. When his hometown begins to vanish into white fog, a young man named Kanata discovers he can bring places back by restoring the memories tied to them.

games.title: Nier: Automata
games.description: An action RPG with fluid hack-and-slash combat, shooter sections and multiple endings that build on each other. In a far future where alien machines have overrun Earth, the android soldiers 2B and 9S are sent down from orbit to win the war for humanity.

games.title: Dragon Quest Builders 2
games.description: A sandbox action RPG with co-op building and a much larger world. A young builder is shipwrecked on the Isle of Awakening after escaping the Children of Hargon, a cult that forbids building, and teams up with the mysterious Malroth to make the island thrive.

games.title: Octopath Traveler
games.description: A turn-based RPG in HD-2D style, with a break-and-boost battle system and eight playable heroes. Eight travelers across the continent of Orsterra, including a dancer, a cleric, a scholar and a thief, each set out on their own journey for their own reasons.

games.title: Imperial SaGa: Eclipse
games.description: A Japan-only browser RPG in the SaGa series and a follow-up to Imperial SaGa, with turn-based battles and characters drawn from across the series.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts III
games.description: An action RPG with theme-park attractions, shotlocks and team attacks, ending the Dark Seeker saga. Sora sets out to regain his lost power of waking, while his friends gather seven guardians of light for the final clash with Master Xehanort and his thirteen seekers of darkness.

games.title: Oninaki
games.description: An action RPG where you fight with possessed weapons called Daemons and cross between the worlds of the living and the dead. Kagachi is a Watcher, charged with guiding lost souls to reincarnation, in a land where mourning the dead too long keeps them from being reborn.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake
games.description: An action RPG that mixes real-time combat with tactical commands, and the first part of a retelling of Final Fantasy VII. Cloud, a mercenary with a mysterious past, joins the rebel group Avalanche against the Shinra corporation in the city of Midgar, while ghostly Whispers try to keep fate on course.

games.title: Bravely Default II
games.description: A turn-based RPG with Brave and Default turns and a job system. Seth, a sailor washed ashore, meets Gloria, a princess of a fallen kingdom, and joins her quest to recover four stolen crystals in the world of Excillant.

games.title: Dungeon Encounters
games.description: A minimalist dungeon crawler where you explore a grid of numbered tiles and fight turn-based battles. A party of adventurers descends through a 100-floor dungeon in search of what lies at the bottom.

games.title: Neo: The World Ends with You
games.description: An action RPG where a team of players controls psychic pins at the same time, set in Shibuya. Rindo and his friend Fret are dragged into a new Reapers' Game, in which teams compete for a week to avoid being erased.

releases.listed_title: Neo: The World Ends with You

games.title: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars
games.description: A tabletop-style RPG presented entirely with cards and a narrator, with dice rolls in turn-based battles. A young man who wants to be a hero sets out to claim a queen's bounty on a dragon that has returned to threaten the land.

releases.listed_title: Voice of Cards: The Isle Dragon Roars

games.title: Babylon's Fall
games.description: An online hack-and-slash action RPG with four-player co-op and four weapons at once. Sentinels, prisoners fitted with mysterious devices called Gideon Coffins, are forced to climb the Tower of Babylon floor by floor.

games.title: Dragon Quest Treasures
games.description: An action RPG about treasure hunting with monster companions. The young siblings Erik and Mia, from Dragon Quest XI's backstory, escape life aboard a Viking ship and land on the floating islands of Draconia, where they hunt for the legendary Dragonstones.

games.title: Harvestella
games.description: A life simulation RPG that combines farming with dungeon crawling, real-time combat and jobs. The four great Seasons Crystals are failing and bringing a deadly season called Quietus, and an amnesiac hero wakes in the village of Lethe and sets out to learn why.

games.title: Star Ocean: The Divine Force
games.description: A real-time action RPG with two protagonists and a flying robot companion called D.U.M.A. The space trader Raymond Lawrence crash-lands on the underdeveloped planet Aster IV and meets Laeticia, a princess of a kingdom at war with a neighboring empire.

games.title: Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origin
games.description: A fast hack-and-slash action RPG with job switching that reimagines the first Final Fantasy. Jack Garland and his companions arrive in Cornelia, each carrying a darkened crystal and one single-minded goal: to kill Chaos.

releases.listed_title: Stranger of Paradise: Final Fantasy Origin

games.title: The Diofield Chronicle
games.description: A real-time tactical RPG where you pause to give orders to squads on the battlefield. Andrias Rhondarson rises through the Blue Fox mercenary company on the island kingdom of DioField, caught between two empires at war over Jade, a source of magic.

games.title: Triangle Strategy
games.description: A tactical RPG in HD-2D with grid battles, where major decisions are settled by party votes on the Scales of Conviction. On the continent of Norzelia, Serenoa, heir to House Wolffort, is caught in a war between three nations over the salt and iron that sustain them.

games.title: Valkyrie Elysium
games.description: A real-time action RPG with combo-focused combat and summoned einherjar spirits. As Ragnarok destroys the world, the dying Allfather Odin creates a Valkyrie and sends her to purify the souls of the dead and stop the end.

games.title: Various Daylife
games.description: A 'daily life and adventure' RPG where characters grow by working jobs, from manual labor to copying books, across more than 20 classes. In year 211 of the Imperial Era, after a new continent is discovered, you live as a colonist in the city of Erebia and plan expeditions into the wilds with limited supplies.

games.title: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden
games.description: A tabletop-style RPG told through cards and a narrator, where you can capture monsters as cards to use in battle. A girl from an underground village hiding from monsters swears revenge after an attack, and gains the power to bind monsters to her will.

releases.listed_title: Voice of Cards: The Beasts of Burden

games.title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden
games.description: A tabletop-style RPG told through cards and a narrator, with dice-based turn battles. On an island chain where maidens protect each island, a boy from the one island without a maiden helps a silent maiden named Laty on her pilgrimage.

releases.listed_title: Voice of Cards: The Forsaken Maiden

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince
games.description: A monster-collecting RPG with synthesis and four-monster parties. Psaro, the half-human son of the demon king, is cursed so that he can't harm monsters, and becomes a monster wrangler in the underworld of Nadiria to win a tournament and overthrow his father.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Dark Prince

games.title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai – Infinity Strash
games.description: An action RPG that retells the anime Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai, with real-time combat and bond cards that grant abilities. Dai, a boy raised on an island of monsters, trains to become a hero and stands against the Dark King Hadlar and his master, the Dark Lord Vearn.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest: The Adventure of Dai – Infinity Strash

games.title: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis
games.description: A free-to-play RPG that retells the Final Fantasy VII saga in episodes, from the original game to Crisis Core, plus an original story about a young Sephiroth. Battles run in real time as you choose commands, with characters and weapons collected over time.

games.title: Final Fantasy XVI
games.description: An action RPG with fast real-time combat and huge battles between summoned creatures called Eikons. In Valisthea, a land kept alive by giant Mothercrystals, Clive Rosfield, firstborn son of a duke, swears revenge after his younger brother, the Dominant of the Phoenix, is killed by a mysterious dark Eikon.

games.title: Forspoken
games.description: An open-world action RPG with magical parkour and fast spellcasting. Frey Holland, a young woman down on her luck in New York, is transported to the land of Athia, where a talking magic cuff helps her survive against the Tantas, rulers who have turned into tyrants.

games.title: Octopath Traveler II
games.description: A turn-based HD-2D RPG with break-and-boost battles, a day and night cycle and eight new heroes. In the land of Solistia, eight travelers, including a dancer, a thief, an apothecary and a prince, each set out on their own journeys across sea and land.

games.title: Emberstoria
games.description: A Japan-only, free-to-play strategy RPG with real-time battles and a floating city to build up. In Purgatory, a land overrun by monsters, humanity revives fallen souls as warriors to survive and push toward the tower at the world's center.

games.title: Fantasian: Neo Dimension
games.description: A turn-based RPG with backgrounds built from handmade dioramas, and a 'Dimengeon' that stores random encounters to fight later in bulk. Leo wakes in a mechanical realm with no memory and travels across many worlds to recover his past as a mechanical infection spreads.

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Rebirth
games.description: An open-world action RPG and the second part of the Final Fantasy VII remake project, with real-time combat and team-up synergy attacks. After escaping Midgar, Cloud and his friends set out across the planet in pursuit of Sephiroth, who is searching for the Promised Land.

games.title: SaGa: Emerald Beyond
games.description: A nonlinear turn-based RPG with a timeline battle system and several protagonists, each with their own story. The heroes travel across seventeen linked worlds, each with its own rules and peoples.

games.title: Visions of Mana
games.description: An action RPG with elemental vessels that change each party member's class and abilities. Every four years, the Faerie chooses Alms, people offered to the Mana Tree, and Val, a Soul Guard, escorts his childhood friend Hinna and the other Alms on their pilgrimage.

games.title: Octopath Traveler 0
games.description: A turn-based HD-2D RPG with a custom hero, town building and up to 30 companions. The hero's hometown of Wishvale is burned by three villains, Herminia, Tytos and Auguste, and the hero travels the continent of Osterra to defeat them and rebuild.

games.title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.description: An upcoming monster-collecting RPG where you recruit, battle and synthesize monsters. Bianca and Nera, two young women whose fathers have fallen ill, travel with a creature named Fluffy to the devastated Kingdom of Witherwood to revive the Leaves of Life.

releases.listed_title: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World

games.title: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.description: A turn-based RPG with stun meters and Visions, summoned spirits of classic Final Fantasy heroes, adapted from the mobile game Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. Rain, Lasswell and Fina set out to protect the world's remaining crystals after Veritas of the Dark destroys the Earth Crystal.

games.title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales
games.description: An HD-2D action RPG with seven weapon types, magic from a fairy companion and puzzle-filled dungeons. Elliot and the fairy Faie travel 250 years into the past through a Doorway of Time to the struggling village of Littlehope, and uncover the history of one nation across four eras.

releases.listed_title: The Adventures of Elliot: The Millennium Tales

games.title: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.description: The upcoming final part of the Final Fantasy VII remake project, with flight across an open world and a full party in battle. Cloud and his allies face Sephiroth as a meteor hangs in the sky and the planet's guardians bring destruction.

games.title: Kingdom Hearts IV
games.description: The upcoming start of the Lost Master saga, an action RPG with a more realistic look. Sora wakes up in Quadratum, a city that resembles the real world, after the events of Kingdom Hearts III.

games.title: Dragon Quest XII: Beyond Dreams
games.description: The upcoming twelfth main Dragon Quest game, announced in 2021 with the subtitle The Flames of Fate. Square Enix has described it as a darker story in which the player's choices shape what happens; few other story details have been shared.
